resources.string: One-tap screenshots from a floating bubble.

Shows the QwiKShot floating bubble on top of other apps. Tap the bubble to take a screenshot, the same as pressing Volume Down + Power.\n\nQwiKShot uses this access only to draw the bubble and press the system screenshot button for you. It does not read what is on your screen, see what you type, or collect any data.
Backup way to draw the bubble. The bubble is normally drawn through the accessibility service in Step 2, so this is only used if your phone refuses that.
Required. This is what lets the bubble float over every app and do its job when you tap it. In the list, open \"%1$s\" and turn it on.
Running. The bubble can float over every app.
Turned on, but Android has not started it. In Accessibility settings, turn \"%1$s\" off and back on.
Installed this APK yourself and the switch is greyed out (\"Restricted setting\")? Open App info, tap the ⋮ menu in the top corner, choose \"Allow restricted settings\", then come back and try again.
The bubble opens Google Drive\'s document scanner, so it needs the Google Drive app.
Tap the bubble to open Drive\'s scanner. When you finish a scan, Drive asks where to save it. Pick a folder to send every scan straight there instead.
Turn on the accessibility service in Step 2 first.
Showing. Tap it over any app to take a screenshot.
Hidden. Turn this on to bring the bubble back.
How see-through the bubble gets after 3 seconds without a touch.
How long the bubble stays hidden before the capture fires. Raise it if the bubble ever shows up in your screenshots.
Takes a screenshot. The bubble hides itself first, so it never shows up in the picture.
Moves it. Let go and it snaps to the nearest side.
Hides the bubble. Turn it back on here.
Screenshot failed. Android rejected the request.
Bubble hidden. Open %1$s to bring it back.
The bubble could not be drawn. Grant the overlay permission in the app.
Could not open that settings screen on this phone.
Could not open Google Drive\'s scanner.
This version of Drive cannot open its scanner directly. Tap + then Scan, or update Google Drive.
Drive did not send back a folder. Try again, or let Drive ask each time.
